QuestInfo.name: The Path of a Warrior
QuestInfo.0: What does it mean to be a Warrior? Talk to #p1002101# in Lith Harbor.
QuestInfo.1: #p1002101# in Lith Harbor says you can choose to become a #bWarrior#k if you're at least #bLevel 10#k. He tells you to see #r#p1022000##k in #rPerion#k. If you'd like to walk there, check your World Map. (#rW#k)
QuestInfo.2: You learned what it takes to be a true Warrior from #p1022000#. You have a feeling this is the right path for you.

0.0: Ah, a Warrior, eh? You chose that because I look so proud as a Warrior, right? Once you're ready, press ACCEPT.

yes.0: A #rWarrior#k favors #bstrength (STR)#k with a bit of dexterity (DEX). Head over to #rPerion#k to talk to #b#p1022000##k.

no.0: Not so sure you want to be a Warrior? Fair enough. Once you decide on a job, come talk to me.

1.0: Are you here to become a Warrior? Then you've come to the right place...

yes.0: Once you get to #bLevel 10#k, I can transform you into a #bWarrior#k. Please see me when you're ready to take the next step.

npc.0: You haven't gone to see #b#p1022000##k yet? He's in #rPerion#k.
